exercises.name: Push Up
exercises.description: A classic bodyweight exercise that strengthens the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: A fundamental lower-body exercise that targets the legs and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Bend your knees and lower your hips.
Push through your feet to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: An isometric core exercise that improves stability and overall core strength.
instructions: Start on your forearms and toes.
Keep your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold the position while keeping your core tight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: An isolation exercise designed to strengthen and build the biceps.
instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower them back down.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: A unilateral lower-body exercise that improves leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent.
Push through the front foot and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: A dynamic cardio exercise that works the core while increasing heart rate.
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Bring one knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs.
Continue alternating at a controlled pace.
